prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset: single finished 1/7 scale Arknights painted PVC figurine product photograph, portrait 1:2, true transparent background. IMAGE 1 supplies ONLY exact character identity, costume, colors and recognizable species/weapon details. IMAGE 2 supplies ONLY the photoreal SOLID 3D FIGURINE MATERIAL, studio light, lens, camera, physical round pedestal and rendering quality. Do not copy image 2's character, ears or outfit. If a third reference is present, it supplies ONLY the small Mon3tr creature design.
Create a REAL SOLID SCULPTURE photographed commercially, with clearly rounded volumes and depth. Sculpted anime face with real projecting nose/chin/cheeks and painted anime eyes, NOT a real human actor. Normal roughly SEVEN-HEAD human proportions, never chibi. Hair is thick tapered physical locks with separation and occlusion shadows, cloth has substantial edges and deep sculpted folds, arms torso and boots show rounded side surfaces and physical thickness. Soft broad realistic PVC specular highlights, semi-matte skin, mildly satin painted costume and hair, realistic occlusion shadows under bangs/collars and boots. Detailed sculptural seams and material edges. No thick black drawn contours, no cel-shaded areas, no flat illustration, no painted concept-art brushstrokes, no cardboard standee or printed acrylic panel.
SERIES CAMERA: rotate the figure about 25 degrees from frontal to show a clear THREE-QUARTER FRONT VIEW, gently looking down about 8 degrees; keep face readable. Upper-left-front large softbox key light with soft shadows and a thin neutral WHITE rear-right rim light. Neutral true costume colors; no colored outline, no blue fringe. Full-body INCLUDING ENTIRE WEAPONS, hair, ears/horns, and COMPLETE PEDESTAL, with 8% clear space at EVERY image edge. Zoom out enough; never crop any tip or sword. Keep long weapons angled close to upright beside body to fit narrow frame. Body and attached base should occupy approximately 85% canvas height and no more than 82% width. The round base has visible ellipse top and deep physical sidewall; boot soles visibly contact its surface. Figure is balanced as a commercially manufactured collectible, minimal discreet support if needed.
Only ONE character sculpture on ONE attached theme pedestal. No image labels, no names, no game rarity border or external effects. Transparent ALPHA around the complete model and inside openings, no studio wall, no floor plane, no external drop shadow, no background gradient or checkerboard image. Effects if specified are physically molded translucent plastic attached to pedestal or figure, not painted floating graphic glow. CHARACTER fig_lappland: Long flowing white hair, white wolf ears and fluffy gray white tail, visible scar over one eye and confident toothy grin. Black high-collar long jacket, dark short shorts, bare pale legs and black shoes. TWO clearly separate swords, one in each hand, close diagonal dynamic pose with both complete blades visible. No extra arms. THEME PEDESTAL AND FINISH: Detailed gray round base with broken paving and three modest rubble blocks; wind-sculpted coat and hair. Rarity purple affects pedestal luxury and paint precision, not background. Preserve approved character identity, E0 outfit and silhouette.
repair_prompt: Edit ONLY the weapons and small eye scar on this exact premium 3D PVC L APPLAND figurine product render (reference 1 is edit target, reference 2 identity/costume support). Keep face, hairstyle, ears, long tail, expression, black outfit, body, legs, pose, shoes, rubble pedestal, camera and realistic solid PVC material unchanged. She must hold TWO UNSHEATHED SWORDS, one in each existing hand. KEEP the existing exposed silver sword in her lowered right hand on the image LEFT. REPLACE the sheath/loop-shaped object and upright handle at image RIGHT with a second fully exposed silver metal sword held by that same existing left hand: clear dark grip, small crossguard, and a continuous long visible silver blade pointing diagonally downward along her image-right side, fully outside the silhouette of her legs and coat. Remove the loop-shaped sheath entirely. Both swords visibly sharp, about matching lengths, both whole tips visible within canvas. Exactly two arms, two hands, two swords, no sheath, no third weapon. Add a subtle recognizable healed scar over her left eye as in character reference without altering her face. Maintain full body and full base and 5% transparent safety margin all around. Genuine transparent alpha background including spaces between blades and body. Preserve solid sculpted locks, thick coat folds, soft studio highlights and 3D physical depth; no drawn outlines or flat painting.
